topic: What payload transponder allocation strategies balance spectral efficiency with dynamic QoS demands from ML traffic classification?
consensus_response: Adaptive payload transponder allocation strategies, such as ECMP and prioritization, balance spectral efficiency with dynamic QoS demands. Beam-hopping techniques enhance spectral efficiency by dynamically allocating capacity based on predicted traffic demands, while phased array antennas optimize beamforming and traffic classification.
reference_context: QoS mechanisms require joint interaction between layer 3 and layer 2 to enable effective QoS in satellite communications.
